title: finance.payroll.paid, schema_version 1
description: Net pay that went out for a payroll run, all at once or in batches: Dr Salaries payable, Cr the account the method names, dated occurred_at. Each batch carries its own payment_reference; without one the run is taken as paid in a single payment.

payment_reference.description: The batch's reference (PR-00001-P1); Finance's source reference for the payment.
